title: We are looking for beta testers
author: eHanani_
selftext:
Hey fellow innovators!

Your journey to confidently explore self-mastery, emotional intelligence, and leadership just got a powerful new companion! The OVUE AI team has been working passionately, and we’re excited to share our vision with you, especially as we unveil our evolving platform—check it out at https://www.ovue.ai/!

OVUE AI is a dynamic toolkit crafted for individuals, teams, and leaders, offering a suite of tools to enhance personal growth, relational strength, and professional success. Guided by Aeva—your private AI concierge—it includes personalized learning assessments, tailored OVUE reports, self-awareness tools, and institutional curated assessments, all driven by AI to foster a deeper understanding of yourself and others.

We’re eagerly seeking beta testers to join our waitlist and help us refine OVUE AI. As a beta participant, you’ll gain early access to the platform and enjoy exclusive perks for shaping its future.

It’s your chance to experience OVUE AI firsthand, share valuable feedback on its features and usability, and help us create the most impactful tool for the self-mastery community.
